why: husky writes the nvm folder as the installing user's home plus /.nvm, and the hook sources nvm.sh from it. That line is put in standard form only for /home/<name>/.nvm, /Users/<name>/.nvm or /root/.nvm; any other folder could hold a planted nvm.sh, so a hook pointing at /tmp/cache/.nvm is not the stock hook and is reviewed (ADR-0072).
